Forever Card Club (FCC)

Summary
- Forever Card Club (FCC) is an all-in-one digital business system for Forever Living Products partners.
- FCC is an independent platform for partners.
- The Forever Card App is the personal app each member receives inside the wider FCC system.
- FCC helps partners present products, share referral paths, capture contacts, guide visitors with AI, and track engagement.
- Product ordering happens through the official Forever webshop in the visitor's country.

Audience
- Forever Living Products partners
- Team leaders who want a clearer digital workflow
- Partners who work both online and in person

Core capabilities
- Personal partner app
- Smart referral links
- AI product assistants
- Lead capture and contact flow
- Analytics and engagement tracking
- NFC card and QR handoff

What FCC solves
- One clear place for partner content, products, contact actions, and recommendations
- Routing visitors toward the correct official Forever webshop
- Turning interest into contacts and follow-up
- Helping visitors discover products and next steps with AI guidance
- Moving in-person meetings into a digital follow-up journey

Brand and legal clarity
- FCC should be described as an independent digital business system for Forever partners.
- The official Forever webshop remains the destination for product ordering.
